name: flat-water-lava-mix
comment: Water and lava meeting on the stone platform. Water source (-5,61,0) and lava source (3,61,0) spread into each other: BlockFluid.checkForHarden turns lava touching water into obsidian (source) or cobblestone (meta 1..4) and fizzes for every level (BlockFluid.java:247-284); lava flowing into water displaces it with the fizz (BlockFlowing.java:116-130). The water reaches a second lava source at (-5,61,4) (obsidian). Lava also displaces a yellow flower on dirt at (3,61,-2) with the fizz and no drop. A still-lava source at (0,61,-5) under a stone cup gets a water source above it at t = 20 (BlockStationary.onNeighborBlockChange, the y+1 check: obsidian). triggerLavaMixEffects draws World.rand twice and Math.random() 16 times (BlockFluid.java:286-293): rng_state every tick.
